versos.grego: Κατήντησεν δὲ καὶ εἰς Δέρβην καὶ εἰς Λύστραν. καὶ ἰδοὺ μαθητής τις ἦν ἐκεῖ ὀνόματι Τιμόθεος, υἱὸς γυναικὸς Ἰουδαίας πιστῆς πατρὸς δὲ Ἕλληνος,

controles.web: He came to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed; but his father was a Greek.
controles.kjv: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
controles.livre: E ele veio a Derbe e Listra; e eis que estava ali um certo discípulo, de nome Timóteo, filho de uma certa mulher judia crente, mas de pai grego.

versos.grego: ὃς ἐμαρτυρεῖτο ὑπὸ τῶν ἐν Λύστροις καὶ Ἰκονίῳ ἀδελφῶν.

controles.web: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
controles.kjv: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
controles.livre: Do qual era bem testemunhado pelos irmãos que estavam em Listra e Icônio.

versos.grego: τοῦτον ἠθέλησεν ὁ Παῦλος σὺν αὐτῷ ἐξελθεῖν, καὶ λαβὼν περιέτεμεν αὐτὸν διὰ τοὺς Ἰουδαίους τοὺς ὄντας ἐν τοῖς τόποις ἐκείνοις· ᾔδεισαν γὰρ ἅπαντες ὅτι Ἕλλην ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ὑπῆρχεν.

controles.web: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts; for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
controles.kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
controles.livre: A este Paulo quis que fosse com ele; e tomando-o, circuncidou-o, por causa dos judeus, que estavam naqueles lugares; porque todos conheciam o pai dele, que era grego.

versos.grego: Ὡς δὲ διεπορεύοντο τὰς πόλεις, παρεδίδοσαν αὐτοῖς φυλάσσειν τὰ δόγματα τὰ κεκριμένα ὑπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων τῶν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις.

controles.web: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E eles, passando pelas cidades, entregavam-lhes as ordenanças que foram determinadas pelos apóstolos e anciãos em Jerusalém, para que as guardassem.

versos.grego: Αἱ μὲν οὖν ἐκκλησίαι ἐστερεοῦντο τῇ πίστει καὶ ἐπερίσσευον τῷ ἀριθμῷ καθ’ ἡμέραν.

controles.web: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
controles.kjv: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
controles.livre: E assim as Igrejas eram firmadas na fé, e cada dia aumentavam em número.

versos.grego: Διῆλθον δὲ τὴν Φρυγίαν καὶ Γαλατικὴν χώραν, κωλυθέντες ὑπὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος λαλῆσαι τὸν λόγον ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ·

controles.web: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
controles.kjv: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
controles.livre: E passando pela Frígia, e pela região da Galácia, foi-lhes impedido pelo Espírito Santo de falarem a palavra na Ásia.

versos.grego: ἐλθόντες δὲ κατὰ τὴν Μυσίαν ἐπείραζον εἰς τὴν Βιθυνίαν πορευθῆναι, καὶ οὐκ εἴασεν αὐτοὺς τὸ Πνεῦμα Ἰησοῦ·

controles.web: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.
controles.kjv: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
controles.livre: E quando eles vieram a Mísia, tentaram ir à Bitínia; mas o Espírito não lhes permitiu.

versos.grego: παρελθόντες δὲ τὴν Μυσίαν κατέβησαν εἰς Τρῳάδα.

controles.web: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
controles.kjv: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
controles.livre: E tendo passado por Mísia, desceram a Trôade.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅραμα διὰ νυκτὸς τῷ Παύλῳ ὤφθη, ἀνὴρ Μακεδών τις ἦν ἑστὼς καὶ παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγων Διαβὰς εἰς Μακεδονίαν βοήθησον ἡμῖν.

controles.web: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him, and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”
controles.kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
controles.livre: E uma visão foi vista por Paulo durante a noite: um homem Macedônio se pôs diante dele ,rogando-lhe, e dizendo: Passa à Macedônia, e ajuda-nos!

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ τὸ ὅραμα εἶδεν, εὐθέως ἐζητήσαμεν ἐξελθεῖν εἰς Μακεδονίαν, συμβιβάζοντες ὅτι προσκέκληται ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς εὐαγγελίσασθαι αὐτούς.

controles.web: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.
controles.kjv: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
controles.livre: E quando ele viu a visão, logo procuramos partir para a Macedônia, concluindo que o Senhor estava nos chamando para anunciarmos o Evangelho a eles.

versos.grego: Ἀναχθέντες δὲ ἀπὸ Τρῳάδος εὐθυδρομήσαμεν εἰς Σαμοθρᾴκην, τῇ δὲ ἐπιούσῃ εἰς Νέαν Πόλιν,

controles.web: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;
controles.kjv: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
controles.livre: Então, tendo navegado desde Trôade, viemos correndo caminho direto a Samotrácia, e no dia seguinte a Neápolis.

versos.grego: κἀκεῖθεν εἰς Φιλίππους, ἥτις ἐστὶν πρώτη τῆς μερίδος Μακεδονίας πόλις, κολωνία. Ἦμεν δὲ ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ πόλει διατρίβοντες ἡμέρας τινάς.

controles.web: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.
controles.kjv: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
controles.livre: E dali a Filipos, que é a primeira cidade desta parte da Macedônia, e é uma colônia; e estivemos naquela cidade por alguns dias.

versos.grego: τῇ τε ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων ἐξήλθομεν ἔξω τῆς πύλης παρὰ ποταμὸν οὗ ἐνομίζομεν προσευχὴν εἶναι, καὶ καθίσαντες ἐλαλοῦμεν ταῖς συνελθούσαις γυναιξίν.

controles.web: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down, and spoke to the women who had come together.
controles.kjv: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
controles.livre: E no dia de sábado saímos para fora da cidade, onde costumava ser feita oração; e tendo nos sentado, falamos às mulheres que tinham se ajuntado ali .

versos.grego: καί τις γυνὴ ὀνόματι Λυδία, πορφυρόπωλις πόλεως Θυατείρων, σεβομένη τὸν Θεόν, ἤκουεν, ἧς ὁ Κύριος διήνοιξεν τὴν καρδίαν προσέχειν τοῖς λαλουμένοις ὑπὸ Παύλου.

controles.web: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us; whose heart the Lord opened to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.
controles.kjv: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
controles.livre: E uma certa mulher, por nome Lídia, vendedora de púrpura, da cidade de Tiatira, que servia a Deus; ela nos ouviu; o coração da qual o Senhor abriu, para que prestasse atenção ao que Paulo dizia.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ ἐβαπτίσθη καὶ ὁ οἶκος αὐτῆς, παρεκάλεσεν λέγουσα Εἰ κεκρίκατέ με πιστὴν τῷ Κυρίῳ εἶναι, εἰσελθόντες εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου μένετε· καὶ παρεβιάσατο ἡμᾶς.

controles.web: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and stay.” So she persuaded us.
controles.kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
controles.livre: E quando ela foi batizada, e também sua casa, ela nos rogou, dizendo: Se vós tendes julgado que eu seja fiel ao Senhor, entrai em minha casa e ficai ali.E ela insistiu para conosco.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ πορευομένων ἡμῶν εἰς τὴν προσευχὴν, παιδίσκην τινὰ ἔχουσαν πνεῦμα Πύθωνα ὑπαντῆσαι ἡμῖν, ἥτις ἐργασίαν πολλὴν παρεῖχεν τοῖς κυρίοις αὐτῆς μαντευομένη.

controles.web: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
controles.livre: E aconteceu, que ao estarmos nós indo à oração, saiu ao nosso encontro uma moça que tinha espírito de pitonisa; a qual ao fazer adivinhações trazia grande lucro a seus senhores.

versos.grego: αὕτη κατακολουθοῦσα τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ ἡμῖν ἔκραζεν λέγουσα Οὗτοι οἱ ἄνθρωποι δοῦλοι τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ Ὑψίστου εἰσίν, οἵτινες καταγγέλλουσιν ὑμῖν ὁδὸν σωτηρίας.

controles.web: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”
controles.kjv: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
controles.livre: Esta, seguindo após Paulo e nós, clamava, dizendo: Estes homens são servos do Deus Altíssimo, que nos anunciam o caminho da salvação.

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ ἐποίει ἐπὶ πολλὰς ἡμέρας. διαπονηθεὶς δὲ Παῦλος καὶ ἐπιστρέψας τῷ πνεύματι εἶπεν Παραγγέλλω σοι ἐν ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐξελθεῖν ἀπ’ αὐτῆς· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ.

controles.web: She was doing this for many days.   But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.
controles.kjv: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
controles.livre: E ela fazia isto por muitos dias. Mas Paulo, estando descontente com isto, virou-se, e disse ao espírito: Em nome de Jesus Cristo eu te mando que saias dela.E na mesma hora o espírito saiu.

versos.grego: Ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ κύριοι αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς ἐργασίας αὐτῶν, ἐπιλαβόμενοι τὸν Παῦλον καὶ τὸν Σιλᾶν εἵλκυσαν εἰς τὴν ἀγορὰν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας,

controles.web: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas, and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
controles.kjv: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
controles.livre: E os senhores dela, vendo que a esperança de lucro deles tinha ido embora, pegaram a Paulo e a Silas, e os levaram à praça, diante dos governantes.

versos.grego: καὶ προσαγαγόντες αὐτοὺς τοῖς στρατηγοῖς εἶπαν Οὗτοι οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἐκταράσσουσιν ἡμῶν τὴν πόλιν, Ἰουδαῖοι ὑπάρχοντες,

controles.web: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city,
controles.kjv: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
controles.livre: E apresentando-os aos magistrados, disseram: Estes homens perturbam nossa cidade, sendo judeus;

versos.grego: καὶ καταγγέλλουσιν ἔθη ἃ οὐκ ἔξεστιν ἡμῖν παραδέχεσθαι οὐδὲ ποιεῖν Ῥωμαίοις οὖσιν.

controles.web: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”
controles.kjv: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
controles.livre: E eles anunciam costumes que não nos é lícito receber, nem fazer; pois somos romanos.

versos.grego: καὶ συνεπέστη ὁ ὄχλος κατ’ αὐτῶν, καὶ οἱ στρατηγοὶ περιρήξαντες αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐκέλευον ῥαβδίζειν,

controles.web: The multitude rose up together against them, and the magistrates tore their clothes off of them, and commanded them to be beaten with rods.
controles.kjv: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
controles.livre: E a multidão se levantou juntamente contra eles; e os oficiais, rasgando suas roupas, mandaram que fossem açoitados.

versos.grego: πολλάς δὲ ἐπιθέντες αὐτοῖς πληγὰς ἔβαλον εἰς φυλακήν, παραγγείλαντες τῷ δεσμοφύλακι ἀσφαλῶς τηρεῖν αὐτούς·

controles.web: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely,
controles.kjv: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
controles.livre: E tendo sido lhes dado muitos açoites, os lançaram na prisão, mandando ao carcereiro que os guardasse em segurança.

versos.grego: ὃς παραγγελίαν τοιαύτην λαβὼν ἔβαλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν ἐσωτέραν φυλακὴν καὶ τοὺς πόδας ἠσφαλίσατο αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ ξύλον.

controles.web: who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.
controles.kjv: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
controles.livre: O qual, tendo recebido tal ordem, lançou-os na cela mais interna, e prendeu-lhes os pés no tronco.

versos.grego: Κατὰ δὲ τὸ μεσονύκτιον Παῦλος καὶ Σιλᾶς προσευχόμενοι ὕμνουν τὸν Θεόν, ἐπηκροῶντο δὲ αὐτῶν οἱ δέσμιοι·

controles.web: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
controles.kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
controles.livre: E perto da meia-noite, Paulo e Silas estavam orando, e cantando hinos a Deus; e os outros presos os escutavam.

versos.grego: ἄφνω δὲ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας, ὥστε σαλευθῆναι τὰ θεμέλια τοῦ δεσμωτηρίου· ἠνεῴχθησαν δὲ παραχρῆμα αἱ θύραι πᾶσαι, καὶ πάντων τὰ δεσμὰ ἀνέθη.

controles.web: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.
controles.kjv: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were loosed.
controles.livre: E de repente houve um terremoto tão grande que os alicerces da prisão se moviam; e logo todas as portas se abriram, e todas as correntes que prendiam a todos se soltaram.

versos.grego: ἔξυπνος δὲ γενόμενος ὁ δεσμοφύλαξ καὶ ἰδὼν ἀνεῳγμένας τὰς θύρας τῆς φυλακῆς, σπασάμενος τὴν μάχαιραν ἤμελλεν ἑαυτὸν ἀναιρεῖν, νομίζων ἐκπεφευγέναι τοὺς δεσμίους.

controles.web: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
controles.kjv: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
controles.livre: E o carcereiro, tendo acordado e visto abertas todas as portas da prisão; puxou a espada, e estava a ponto de se matar, pensando que os presos tinham fugido.

versos.grego: ἐφώνησεν δὲ Παῦλος μεγάλῃ φωνῇ λέγων Μηδὲν πράξῃς σεαυτῷ κακόν, ἅπαντες γάρ ἐσμεν ἐνθάδε.

controles.web: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”
controles.kjv: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
controles.livre: Mas Paulo clamou em alta voz, dizendo: Não te faças nenhum mal, porque todos nós estamos aqui.

versos.grego: αἰτήσας δὲ φῶτα εἰσεπήδησεν καὶ ἔντρομος γενόμενος προσέπεσεν τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ Σιλᾷ,

controles.web: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
controles.kjv: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
controles.livre: E tendo pedido luzes, saltou para dentro, e termendo muito, ele se prostrou diante de Paulo e Silas.

versos.grego: καὶ προαγαγὼν αὐτοὺς ἔξω ἔφη Κύριοι, τί με δεῖ ποιεῖν ἵνα σωθῶ;

controles.web: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
controles.kjv: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
controles.livre: E levando-os para fora, disse: Senhores, o que me é necessário fazer para eu me salvar?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Πίστευσον ἐπὶ τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, καὶ σωθήσῃ σὺ καὶ ὁ οἶκός σου.

controles.web: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
controles.kjv: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
controles.livre: E eles lhe disseram: Crê no Senhor Jesus Cristo, e serás salvo, tu e a tua casa.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλάλησαν αὐτῷ τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.
controles.kjv: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
controles.livre: E lhe falaram da palavra do Senhor, e a todos os que estavam em sua casa.

versos.grego: καὶ παραλαβὼν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ τῆς νυκτὸς ἔλουσεν ἀπὸ τῶν πληγῶν, καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ αὐτοῦ ἅπαντες παραχρῆμα,

controles.web: He took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.
controles.kjv: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
controles.livre: E ele, tomando-os consigo, naquela mesma hora da noite, lavou -lhes as feridas dos açoites, e logo foi batizado, ele e todos os seus.

versos.grego: ἀναγαγών τε αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν οἶκον παρέθηκεν τράπεζαν, καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο πανοικεὶ πεπιστευκὼς τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: He brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his household, having believed in God.
controles.kjv: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
controles.livre: E tendo os levado a sua casa, pôs comida diante deles à mesa; e alegrou-se muito, tendo crido em Deus com toda a sua casa.

versos.grego: Ἡμέρας δὲ γενομένης ἀπέστειλαν οἱ στρατηγοὶ τοὺς ῥαβδούχους λέγοντες Ἀπόλυσον τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἐκείνους.

controles.web: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”
controles.kjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
controles.livre: E sendo já de dia, os magistrados mandaram aos guardas, dizendo: Solta aqueles homens.

versos.grego: ἀπήγγειλεν δὲ ὁ δεσμοφύλαξ τοὺς λόγους τούτους πρὸς τὸν Παῦλον, ὅτι Ἀπέσταλκαν οἱ στρατηγοὶ ἵνα ἀπολυθῆτε. νῦν οὖν ἐξελθόντες πορεύεσθε ἐν εἰρήνῃ.

controles.web: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out, and go in peace.”
controles.kjv: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
controles.livre: E o carcereiro anunciou estas palavras a Paulo, dizendo : Os magistrados têm mandado vos soltar; portanto agora saí, e ide em paz.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Παῦλος ἔφη πρὸς αὐτούς Δείραντες ἡμᾶς δημοσίᾳ ἀκατακρίτους, ἀνθρώπους Ῥωμαίους ὑπάρχοντας, ἔβαλαν εἰς φυλακήν· καὶ νῦν λάθρᾳ ἡμᾶς ἐκβάλλουσιν; οὐ γάρ, ἀλλὰ ἐλθόντες αὐτοὶ ἡμᾶς ἐξαγαγέτωσαν.

controles.web: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly, without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”
controles.kjv: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
controles.livre: Mas Paulo lhes disse: Eles nos açoitaram publicamente, e sem sermos sentenciados, sendo nós homens romanos, lançaram-nos na prisão, e agora nos lançam fora às escondidas? Assim não! Mas que eles mesmos venham e nos tirem.

versos.grego: ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ τοῖς στρατηγοῖς οἱ ῥαβδοῦχοι τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα. ἐφοβήθησαν δὲ ἀκούσαντες ὅτι Ῥωμαῖοί εἰσιν,

controles.web: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,
controles.kjv: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
controles.livre: E os guardas voltaram para dizer aos magistrados estas palavras; e eles temeram ao ouvirem que eram romanos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθόντες παρεκάλεσαν αὐτούς, καὶ ἐξαγαγόντες ἠρώτων ἀπελθεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως.

controles.web: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.
controles.kjv: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
controles.livre: E tendo vindo, rogaram-lhes; e tirando-os, pediram -lhes que saíssem da cidade.

versos.grego: ἐξελθόντες δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλακῆς εἰσῆλθον πρὸς τὴν Λυδίαν, καὶ ἰδόντες παρεκάλεσαν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἐξῆλθαν.

controles.web: They went out of the prison, and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, and departed.
controles.kjv: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
controles.livre: E eles, tendo saído da prisão, entraram na casa de Lídia; e vendo aos irmãos, consolaram-lhes; e saíram.
